title: Balancing Exploration and Exploitation in Constrained Combinatorial Optimization with U(1)-Symmetric Tensor Trains
abstract: arXiv:2611.22557v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tensor Train (TT) decomposition has emerged as a powerful tool for mitigating the curse of dimensionality in a variety of machine learning and combinatorial optimization tasks. Recent advances show that TT-based generative models can efficiently represent and explore high-dimensional discrete spaces, even when the cost function structure is unknown. However, incorporating hard linear constraints into TT-based optimization remains challenging, as existing interpolation and sampling approaches often fail when feasible points are rare. In this work, we develop a general TT-based framework for constrained combinatorial optimization built upon U(1)-symmetric tensor networks. Our method introduces an expressibility-enhancement mechanism for constructing sparse symmetric tensors and a graph-based diversity measure that guides sample selection during training. translated_title: 基于U(1)对称张量列车的约束组合优化中探索与利用的平衡
translated_abstract: 张量列车分解已成为在多种机器学习和组合优化任务中缓解维度灾难的强大工具。最近的研究进展表明，基于张量列车的生成模型能够高效地表示和探索高维离散空间，即使代价函数的结构未知。然而，将硬线性约束融入基于张量列车的优化仍然具有挑战性，因为现有的插值和采样方法在可行点稀少时常常失效。在本工作中，我们基于U(1)对称张量网络，开发了一个用于约束组合优化的通用张量列车框架。我们的方法引入了一种用于构建稀疏对称张量的表达能力增强机制，以及一种基于图的多样性度量来指导训练过程中的样本选择。在分配问题基准测试中，表达能力增强和多样性感知选择……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个基于U(1)对称张量网络的约束组合优化通用框架，通过表达能力增强机制和基于图的多样性感知样本选择，在可行点稀少的硬约束问题上有效平衡了探索与利用。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a general U(1)-symmetric tensor train framework for constrained combinatorial optimization, balancing exploration and exploitation via an expressibility-enhancement mechanism and graph-based diversity-aware sample selection.
